question: Which of the following monuments has been declared a national monument by the Prime Minister of India in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangarh Dham.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangarh Dham** has been declared a national monument by the** Prime Minister of India** in **November 2022.**
 
• Mangarh Dham is located in the **Banswara district of Rajasthan, India.**
 
• It is dedicated to** Lord Hanuman **and is believed to have been built by the **Pandavas during the Mahabharata era.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rukhmini Temple** is a famous temple located in **Dwarka, Gujarat, India.**

 
 
• It is dedicated to **Goddess Rukmini, **the consort of Lord Krishna. 
 
 
 
• **Musa Bagh** is a historical garden located in **Lahore, Pakistan.**
 
 
• It was built during the** Mughal era **and is known for its beautiful architecture and Mughal-style gardens.
 
 
 
• **Gol Gumbaz **is a famous monument located in **Bijapur, Karnataka, **India.
 
 
• It is known for its impressive architecture and is one of the **largest domes** in the world.
